violation_type.title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Secure Each Child Appropriate System According to Manufacturers Instructions (26 TAC §747.5407(c))
violation_type.short_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Secure Each Child Appropriate System According to Manufacturers Instructions
violation_type.typical_finding: Children are transported without the proper use of car seats. The deficiency is related to a DFPS Abuse/Neglect investigation.

finding_variants.text: Children are transported without the proper use of car seats. The deficiency is related to a DFPS Abuse/Neglect investigation.
No safety seat mechanisms were observed in the providers vehicle used to transport the school age children from the Elementary school to the providers residence.
